_doc: Which PMD SpriteCollab animation a fighter plays for each game action (docs/PMD_SPRITES.md). Every value is a fallback chain: the first animation the species has wins; an empty chain end means 'keep the current loop'. 'states' are looping body states, picked by priority (first true wins). 'kinds' map a move's kind to a one-shot; 'moves' override a single move id. Hold rules: dash holds RushFrame while the dash runs; stream/beam hold HitFrame until the cast ends; Faint holds its last frame. 'pin_feet' are the anims the importer anchors on each frame's own feet (no drawn bob); every other anim anchors on its shadow point. 'rates' scale a single anim's playback speed (default 1.0).

flap._doc: Wind moves: a flyer loops its wing-beat anim (first in chain it has) at rate for the move's duration (min secs) instead of the kind's one-shot; species without one use the normal chain.

swoop._doc: D107: dash moves that travel the body but are a wing swing, so they play their one-shot (Attack) instead of holding RushFrame for the dash's whole run.
